info.name: Services.AutoTrading Account Values Trading Conditions - Contract Option API
Get trading conditions for a contract option.

params.name: AccountKey
params.description: The account key to lookup the conditions for

params.name: FieldGroups
params.description: Specify which field groups to return

params.name: OptionRootId
params.description: The optionRootId for the option to lookup

params.name: Uic
params.description: The uic for the instrument to lookup

items.docs:
Trading conditions for all exchange traded options and synthetic options(OTC). 
             Trading conditions details default behavior for the option (can it be traded and how), 
             margin requirements for opening and holding a position in an option (how much cash is needed on the account) 
             as well as the cost structure of opening, closing and holding a position.
